title: Literary Narrative as Moral Probe: A Cross-System Framework for Evaluating AI Ethical Reasoning and Refusal Behavior
reasoning: The paper introduces the Moral Reasoning Depth Scale (MRDS) and the Refusal Taxonomy (RT-5) specifically to evaluate AI ethical and moral reasoning capacity. It also includes a dedicated 'theological differentiator probe' that tests AI systems' ability to engage with a fictional Catholic ontology involving concepts of souls, salvation, and damnation.
